vars.team_intro: For significant features or changes that are more than a few lines of code, use [Claude Code agent teams](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams) with a structured multi-agent approach.
vars.guard_hooks: A `PreToolUse` hook blocks the engineer's edits to sealed files and holdout reads where the agent is identifiable, and a `TaskCompleted` hook blocks completing any task while a sealed test is modified.
